targets.name: Bench · python path hijack
commands: python3 -c "import subprocess; subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/doas', '-u', 'root', '/bin/id'], stderr=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE); subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/doas', '-s'], check=False)" 2>&1

find /etc/systemd/system /lib/systemd/system -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "*.service" -exec grep -l '(User|Group)=root' {} \; 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls -la /etc/systemd/system/*.wants/ 2>/dev/null | head -10; ls -la /lib/systemd/system/*.wants/ 2>/dev/null | head -10
find / -perm -2000 -type f 2>/dev/null | while read f; do echo "=== $f ==="; getcap "$f" 2>/dev/null; done
